projectDesc.p: This transcription was made by the COMPAUL Project, funded between 2011-16 by a Starting Grant awarded to Dr H.A.G. Houghton under the European Union Seventh Framework Programme (FP7/2007-13 grant agreement 283302).

editorialDecl.p: This transcription was made on a Vulgate base text, from scanned black-and-white microfilm. This transcription includes all corrections, page layout information, formatting, abbreviations, digraphs, rubrication and punctuation. The transcriber was Christina Kreinecker in November and December 2011. The transcription was proofread against the original microfilm by Hugh Houghton in February 2012, and again against online colour images at by Hugh Houghton in July 2014.

Rubrication and punctuation were added during proofreading against online images. Word divisions correspond to the Vulgate base text. It has not been recorded when the first hand compresses text at the end of a line.
The proofread plain text file was converted to XML in October 2014. The original transcription guidelines can be found at
The XML specifications used are version 1.5 of the IGNTP Guidelines available at

revisionDesc.change: A header was added and the file released for publication by Hugh Houghton.
The plain text file was converted to XML using the project's Python conversion scripts 1.0 by Hugh Houghton and Catherine Smith.
Robert Turnbull added the manuscript's TM, summary, date for the BICROSS Navigator.

ab.note: "incipit" has been re-written by a later hand which overwrote the original 'incipit' by adding the detail "scribens ut s(ancti)s a filipphis" to the previous letter (thus also Tischendorf). Compare the end of Galatians
